title: Mildred's wit
summary: Her sharp humor sometimes worked against her, and she could have been a comedian.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Yeah, I quite agree with you, I do too. One thing, of course, that worked against her in a way, I mean she had a wonderful gift of wit. Her wit was tremendous, wasn't it? She was the wittiest thing in the world. The funniest thing in the world.
And, of course, being that way, a person that's like that can see funny things were -- where a less sharp person doesn't see it so funny, right away --
-- and of course she -- and then she would say it in her way and send you into hysterics. And -- of

course sometimes, maybe that worked against her, maybe. Because you know, we're all funny at times and if anybody looks at you and sees where you're funny and says so and then it's repeated to somebody --
Oh, gosh, we used to laugh.
But she couldn't help herself on that. I mean she could've been a terrific comedian.
Oh sure. Oh, sure she could.
